title: Concept: Kiali console is reachable without authentication
description: The mesh topology is an architecture diagram of the platform: service names, namespaces and the request graph. It also carries the traffic rates, which tell the caller which service is busiest and therefore which one to target.
applicability: Responses that serve a service-mesh console on a reachable host.
risk: The caller reconstructs the internal service graph and its request volumes.
